propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO which do not exist in live REB Jira, causing ACLI to reject JQL queries like 'project = LEG AND status != Done' with parse error

The story-1734 multi-project fan-out in fetcher._build_snapshot reads all keys from projects.json and issues one inbound query per key, so the first nonexistent project key causes the entire pass to exit with status 1

The .bridge_state/projects.json corruption arrived via ad-hoc git commits on the live tickets branch (commits 9f1b2cff98 and 275bd7507e by test-fixture identity) rather than through the isolated DC rehearsal harness, violating the concurrency contract

The canonical intended state for live origin/tickets:.bridge_state/projects.json is the single-project configuration with empty projects dict and legacy_default REB (byte-identical to ensure-registry seed)
Bridge-state writes lack unified store write lock, commit atomicity, and auto-publish semantics, enabling the ad-hoc hand-commits that caused the leak
